== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster explicitly describes deployment when Malakili is not alone and names the habitat qualification. Both preserve the Tatooine discount, defence bonus, protection from the Rancor, and a single Rancor pull. The period rulebook explains that the Rancor text changes deployment conditions while retaining deployment cost.
